script_text:
Why do Virgos hurt your feelings even when they're right?
Because once a Virgo sees what's wrong, they want to correct it. Fast.
Maybe you broke a promise. Maybe one part of your story doesn't add up. They're listening for what happened. You're waiting for them to notice how you feel.
Then you say, "It's how you said it."
And they come back with, "But was I wrong?"
That's the fight. You want them to care that it hurt. They want you to admit they were right.
Sometimes Virgo needs to stop proving the point for a second and just listen.
